name: Winter Opens Its Eye
objective: The Herald returns, unbound, to stop the Chorus being rung on anyone's terms but its master's. Hold the summit until midnight.
intro: The glacier does not split this time. It simply opens, like an eye. What climbs out is not Pokémon-shaped anymore.
dialogue: The Frost Herald — Unbound: "SIX OF SIX. WINTER OPENS ITS EYE."
The Frost Herald — Unbound (defeated): "...THE CHORUS... CHANGES... THE TUNE..."
lore_discovery: The Herald is beaten down as midnight strikes — and hears the first note of the Chorus ring out over the summit. For the first time, it kneels. It was never the master. It was the leash.
